verdict.rationale: Plausible offers funnel analysis, goals, and aggregate metrics, but there is no evidence of retention curves or behavioral cohort segmentation; by design Plausible avoids storing per-user identifiers or building user profiles (no personal data, no fingerprinting) which is structurally incompatible with cohort-based retention analysis. Community evidence even notes the founders 'refuse to adopt tracking of user flows through a site... for privacy reasons,' underscoring this gap rather than just an absence of docs.
